text:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Record sweep-off misses in terminal miss records**

When a matched sweep-off control exists and all three compared reviewers are clean, a human-only confirmed defect was also missed by the control, but this enum can record only the sweep-enabled and external misses and declares those two sufficient for terminality. AC15(d) then uses that same defect to calculate the sweep-off arm's recall, leaving implementations to invent a control-miss code or close the head without explicitly adjudicating that arm. Add a sweep-off miss entry and require it whenever a control is among the compared reviewers.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/90a694eabddd7a1d3a45d741c85e45d0c19df7b6/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
